Select the first 1000 IC50 activity rows with pChEMBL values for the human single-protein target CHEMBL1293258 (Mothers against decapentaplegic homolog 3). Join activities to assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL1293258, standard_type IC50, standard_relation '=', and pchembl_value not null. Return assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, and pchembl_value. Order results by molecule_chembl_id and assay_chembl_id.
